source_record.description:
much. Consulting is an ERP & automation consultancy with 120 people in Germany, Portugal and the UK. We grow fast and profitable, which gives us room to make bold moves. Next up: building a finance function that matches our size and starting to acquire competitors.

The role
You join as the first finance leader of the group and report directly to the CEO. Your job is to take our finance function to the next level and kickstart our M&A. You work with a small team and our external tax advisors (in all countries) and a lot of freedom in how you build things. Nothing is set in stone and much needs improvement. You'll build processes from scratch, fix what's broken yourself and decide what's worth doing at all.

Tasks

  • Develop and control cash, business plan and budgets
  • Maintain transfer pricing and intercompany agreements together with our advisors
  • Be our treasurer, find savings in our cost base and see them through
  • Work on acquisitions: financial models, due diligence, financing and integrating new companies into group reporting

Requirements

  • 3 to 6 years in audit, transaction services or finance at a growing company
  • Deep accounting and controlling knowledge, ideally across multiple countries
  • You learn fast and enjoy taking on things you haven't done before
  • You act like it's your own money, because at our size every euro you save shows up
  • You'd rather build the cash forecast yourself than write a concept for it
  • You prefer working with data in systems over manual processes; SQL or ERP experience helps
  • Fluent in English and German (both min. C1)

Benefits

  • A seat at the table for every deal and every major decision
  • Short decision paths. If you have a good idea on Monday, it can be live by Friday.
  • A role that grows with the group, with a path to CFO
  • Office in Munich, hybrid with 2 home office days per week
  • 90k€ fixed salary plus an annual performance bonus tied to clear, jointly defined goals

We have much. to do.

Apply now!

Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
